newsitem.title: USA: FAA suspends HCL Aviation's Av Atlantic.
newsitem.headline: FAA suspends HCL Aviation's Av Atlantic.

text.p: The Federal Aviation Administration, in an emergency order Friday, suspended HCL Aviation's Av Atlantic airline for a number of maintenance and safety violations.
The small Savannah, Georgia-based airline flies a fleet of seven Boeing 727 aircraft for use as charters or in service to other carriers.
The FAA, among a series of charges, said flight attendents were improperly trained, that the carrier did not properly maintain the aircraft, and that there were missing or inoperative safety devices.
"The emergency order of suspension will continue until Av Atlantic satisfactorily demonstrate that it can comply with federal aviation regulations," the FAA said in a statement.
